Posts.RecruitPostName: Senior Legal Counsel (Overseas Advertising Platform & Public Welfare Projects Compliance)
Posts.Responsibility:
What the Role Entails
Tencent is looking for a Senior Legal Counsel focusing on overseas advertising platform and public welfare initiatives. As one of the key members in the Tencent overseas legal team, you will have an exciting opportunity to support international business, products and platforms in the areas of advertising, open-source software and AI across multiple jurisdictions.
Key Responsibilities
Advise on the legal and compliance aspects of overseas advertising platforms, including product features, platform governance, advertiser onboarding, ad review workflows, user-facing disclosures, and cross-border launches
Build and improve the compliance framework for the overseas advertising business, including policies, standard operating procedures, risk assessments, approval workflows, training, and knowledge management.
Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including advertiser, agency, ad-tech, vendor, media-buying, and platform service agreements, as well as data-related and general commercial contracts.
Conduct legal assessments and market entry research covering advertising and marketing regulation, consumer protection, privacy and data protection, content moderation, and sector-specific requirements.
Provide strategic, end-to-end legal and compliance support for the global expansion and implementation of overseas public welfare initiatives, including contract review, legal risk assessment, governance support and other legal work across the project lifecycle.
Collaborate with external counsel and other Tencent attorneys based around the world, including in mainland China, Singapore, the EU, the US and other relevant jurisdictions, to provide practical compliance and regulatory analysis for international business initiatives.
Identify legal and regulatory risks early, and develop practical, scalable solutions for business, product, and platform teams.

Who We Look For
Key expectations and criteria:
Education: Exceptional academic credentials, including an advanced law degree from a prestigious, internationally recognized law school. Admission to practice in a major overseas jurisdiction is strongly preferred.
Experience: Minimum of 5 years of post-qualification experience gained at leading international law firms and/or multinational corporations. Proven experience in advertising, media, platform businesses, commercial contracting, regulatory compliance, and cross-border legal matters is strongly preferred.
Compliance Systems Experience: Hands-on experience in building or enhancing compliance frameworks, including policies, template documentation, approval workflows, training programs, and knowledge management tools, with the ability to drive operational efficiency in line with both international standards and local regulatory requirements.
Business Judgment: Sound business acumen with the ability to deliver practical, commercially pragmatic, and comprehensive legal advice in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to build trusted, effective relationships with business stakeholders across different functions and levels.
Independence & Project Management: Ability to work independently, effectively prioritize competing demands, and manage end-to-end project processes—from initial legal assessment and contract negotiation through to implementation and post-launch risk management.
Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable operating under pressure in a fast-paced, constantly evolving technology environment, with the ability to handle complex, time-sensitive, and multi-jurisdictional matters.
Learning Agility: Quick learner with a genuine interest in the latest developments in overseas advertising regulation, platform compliance, and emerging technologies.
Language: Fluency in both Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken) as working languages.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: China-Shenzhen | Hong Kong

Posts.RecruitPostName: Legal Counsel, Cloud
Posts.Responsibility:
What the Role Entails
Responsibilities
Advise on a wide range of legal and commercial matters, including cloud services, AI, technology licensing, open source software, and export control compliance.
Draft, review, and negotiate complex software licensing, cloud services, cloud infrastructure, channel distribution agreements, and other general commercial agreements.
Collaborate with external counsel and other Tencent attorneys worldwide (around 500 lawyers) , including in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Singapore, the EU, the UK and the US, to provide compliance and regulatory analysis for international business initiatives.
Identify potential legal risks, compliance gaps and regulatory challenges, and prepare creative, practical solutions to help business teams mitigate risks.
Develop, implement and monitor internal compliance policies, knowledge management systems , and processes to address compliance issues, ensuring alignment with international regulatory standards.

Create and deliver online training materials to educate business stakeholders and product teams on evolving laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.
Advise management on the implications of legal and regulatory developments.

Who We Look For
Qualifications
We would like our candidate to have:
5-7 years of experience working in a law firm or in‑house legal department in the areas of technology, online platforms, cloud services, software development, or similar industry sectors.
Strong academic credentials and membership in a relevant Bar, or possession of other recognized professional qualifications or equivalent membership. A second degree in computer science, engineering, or a similar subject is an advantage.
A track record of making sound business judgments and the ability to deliver practical, commercially‑friendly, and comprehensive advice.
Detail‑oriented, with extensive experience in legal compliance, commercial matters, intellectual property, and licensing transactions in cloud computing, AI, technology development, and bespoke tech projects.
The ability to prioritize in a fast‑paced environment, independently manage day‑to‑day compliance work, and handle the end‑to‑end transaction process from initial contract review through to negotiation and execution.
Excellent communication skills (written and oral) in Mandarin Chinese and English, enabling effective collaboration with international stakeholders and those based at Mainland China HQ
Be proactive, a strong team player, and able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with business stakeholders.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: China-Shenzhen
